name: smwgraphics-resplendent-grassland-sets
title: Resplendent Grassland Sets
description:
Sets of grassland graphics, all intended to go together, including an FG, three BGs, and two layer three BGs. The FG includes animated flowers and grass. The blue hill BG features animated clouds.

Some tiles are designed to go with my Resplendent Global Graphics.

Moderator's note: requires this patch for the status bar to not appear behind other layers. Alternatively, use a sprite status bar patch.
